statement_record.book: Sophisticated recasting of Theorem 1 using Δ ⊣ Lim: in the square of adjoint pairs relating (F^J, G^J) : X^J ⇀ A^J to (F, G) : X ⇀ A along the diagonal/limit adjunctions one has F^J Δ = Δ F, so the square of LEFT adjoints commutes; since composites of adjoints are adjoints and right adjoints are unique up to natural isomorphism, Lim ◯ G^J ≅ G ◯ Lim. Hence for T : J ⟶ A with limit a, Ga = G Lim T = Lim GT, and G carries limiting cones to limiting cones, the limiting cone being the value at T of the counit of Δ ⊣ Lim.
